get.description: Audit rows newest first, optionally filtered by `action` or `actor`.

post.description:
Verifies credentials and issues a short-lived access token (`NE1105` on failure).

Both the success and the failure are audited (the email is the target); the token and
the password are never logged or stored in the audit detail.

get.description: Reads a build with its diagnostics and artifact list.
Downloads one output file; `X-Content-SHA256` carries its hash.

Which `neuron` commands and toolchains this image has, and the job limits.

Needs no database. The probe runs once per process and is cached.
Daemons and their deployment status (online/offline by the heartbeat timeout).

delete.description: Unpairs a daemon: revokes its token and closes its relay sockets (engineer only).

get.description: Device summaries only. Needs `device.read` (a guest is `NE1106`).
The whole catalog: every device and medium manifest (public).
One device manifest by name, or a 404. Needs `device.read` (a guest is `NE1106`).

post.description: Issues a guest sandbox and a token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Issues a one-time pairing code for a cell (engineer only).
Claims a code and returns a daemon service token (public; the daemon has no token yet).

get.description: Lists projects, newest first; a guest sees only its own sandbox's projects.

post.description:
Creates an empty project. A guest's project is bound to its sandbox and counts
against the sandbox project quota (`NE1104`).

put.description: Renames a project; a stale `row_version` is `NE1107`. A guest renames only its own.

get.description: Lists the versions of a project, newest first, without file contents.

post.description:
Stores a new immutable version holding exactly the files sent.

A guest gets tighter file limits (`NE1101` over them): fewer files and smaller files.

get.description: Lists every service token's metadata (never a secret), newest first.

post.description: Issues a service token. The secret is returned once and never stored in clear.

delete.description: Revokes a token; a missing or already-revoked token is a 404.

get.description: Reads a version with its files.
Lists the builds of a version, newest first.

post.description:
Accepts a build; it runs in the background. Poll `GET /v1/builds/{id}`.

A guest's build counts against the sandbox per-day build quota (`NE1104`).
